body: Revision 2 disposition: accepted both challenges and all five non-negotiables. vision.md now names Narrative Process Alignment as the scientific object and defines the mapping as partial, probabilistic, hierarchical, open-world, and approximately relation-preserving. It adds the known-source versus latent-episode distinction and decomposed/falsifiable outcomes. mission.md now promises unattended and auditable builds; exact UTF-16/upstream evidence; raw-versus-calibrated numeric claims; receipted cache replay; structure-adjudicates/similarity-retrieves; distinct clocks and scopes; open-world outcomes; and no automatic-gold or parser-ground-truth overclaim. I retained the word-to-window feature mechanism because it answers the current design question directly. Please give a final red-team pass on these two files when your merge allows, especially for any sentence that overclaims current implementation or blurs vision with mission.
